svg.title: PRINT & PREPARE · two pieces
svg.desc: 1 Print the front on one plate and its matching back on the other. 2 Glue three six by three millimeter magnets into the rear pockets, seat flush and let the adhesive cure.

g.text: Seat flush · let the glue cure

svg.text: CAD-based silhouettes · exploded details schematic · use each frame’s matching parts
